name: Ngx Prime Default
tagline: SSR-ready Angular 22 landing starter with Tailwind and signal-based theming
description: A prerender-first Angular 22 starter built for fast marketing and business landing pages. Ships with SSR/prerender wired up, Tailwind CSS, light/dark theming on CSS variables, and a bootstrap layer for company data and multilingual content.
features: Angular 22 with SSR and build-time prerendering
Tailwind CSS with a shared design-token theme (light and dark)
Company bootstrap layer backed by signals
SEO metadata wired through route data

name: Ngx Prime Sakai
tagline: Angular 22 admin dashboard, forked from the PrimeTek Sakai template
description: An Angular 22 admin dashboard template forked from PrimeTek's Sakai design, rebuilt on PrimeNG for internal tools, back-office panels, and client dashboards.
features: Angular 22 admin shell with PrimeNG components
Ready-made dashboard, tables, and form layouts
Responsive sidebar navigation and layout system
Structured for adding new admin modules quickly

name: Ngx Prime Demo (Placeholder)
